message.content:
I'm sorry to hear you've been dealing with headaches. While I can't diagnose your specific situation, I can share some general guidance to help you assess the situation.

**When to seek medical attention promptly:**

- Sudden, severe "thunderclap" headache (the worst headache of your life)
- Headache after a head injury
- Fever, stiff neck, confusion, seizures, or vision changes
